tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
An OpenAI engineer has been arrested by the FBI for installing a hidden recording device in an executive room. Still open, per Central Oregon Daily: three researchers were also fired over policy violations.
An OpenAI employee allegedly used a chatbot to help plant a listening device in a conference room. Confirmed by Wired: the employee faces up to five years in prison.
An OpenAI employee has been arrested for placing a spy device in a conference room. Still open, per Schwäbische.de: details on the incident continue to emerge.
An OpenAI engineer was arrested for allegedly spying on internal meetings with hidden recording devices. Confirmed by Washington Examiner: the engineer was charged after the devices were discovered.
xAI has launched The X Subscription with a thirty dollar premium plan offering tiered tools and shared Grok model access. Reported by Technobezz: the subscription service is now available.
Free every hour.
